# Hangbug

> Hangbug is a free interactive technology learning and skill assessment platform where students and developers practice technology-related multiple-choice (MCQ) quizzes, test programming and web development knowledge, play coding and typing games, track quiz performance and progress, earn score-based certificates, and share earned certificates on LinkedIn.

## Core Platform

- [Home](https://www.hangbug.com/): Interactive programming quizzes, coding games, and developer skill assessment.
- [Technology Quizzes](https://www.hangbug.com/technologies): Browse technology quiz tracks across frontend, backend, databases, and mobile.
- [Coding Games](https://www.hangbug.com/games): Interactive browser-based developer coding and typing challenges.
- [Leaderboard](https://www.hangbug.com/leaderboard): Global developer rankings and quiz achievements.
- [Verify Certificates](https://www.hangbug.com/certificate/view): Verify developer completion certificates by certificate ID.
- [Blog & Tutorials](https://www.hangbug.com/blog): Software engineering tutorials, interview preparation, and best practices.

## Technology Quiz Tracks

- [HTML](https://www.hangbug.com/technologies/html): Semantic markup, modern HTML5 elements, and accessibility.
- [CSS](https://www.hangbug.com/technologies/css): Flexbox, Grid, animations, responsive design, and CSS3 styling.
- [JavaScript](https://www.hangbug.com/technologies/javascript): ES6+ syntax, asynchronous programming, DOM, and prototypes.
- [React](https://www.hangbug.com/technologies/react): Component lifecycle, hooks, state management, and JSX.
- [PHP](https://www.hangbug.com/technologies/php): Server-side scripting, object-oriented PHP, and web development.
- [Laravel](https://www.hangbug.com/technologies/laravel): MVC architecture, routing, Eloquent ORM, and Blade templates.
- [MySQL](https://www.hangbug.com/technologies/mysql): Relational database queries, joins, indexes, and schema design.
- [MongoDB](https://www.hangbug.com/technologies/mongodb): NoSQL document modeling, CRUD operations, and aggregation pipelines.
- [Flutter](https://www.hangbug.com/technologies/flutter): Cross-platform UI, widget composition, state, and routing.
- [Dart](https://www.hangbug.com/technologies/dart): Object-oriented programming, null safety, async/await, and collections.
- [Python](https://www.hangbug.com/technologies/python): Syntax, data structures, OOP, modules, and algorithm challenges.
- [Programming Fundamentals](https://www.hangbug.com/technologies/programming-fundamentals): Algorithms, data structures, and computer science basics.

## Developer Games

- [Code Puzzle](https://www.hangbug.com/games/code-puzzle): Arrange jumbled code blocks into functional algorithms.
- [Find The Bug](https://www.hangbug.com/games/find-the-bug): Inspect source snippets and locate logic and syntax errors.
- [Output Predictor](https://www.hangbug.com/games/output-predictor): Trace code execution and predict exact program output.
- [SQL Challenge](https://www.hangbug.com/games/sql-challenge): Write and debug relational SQL queries under time constraints.
- [Speed Typing](https://www.hangbug.com/games/speed-typing): Benchmark coding and technical typing speed in WPM.
- [Code Typing](https://www.hangbug.com/games/code-typing): Practice real-world programming syntax and symbols.
- [Code Scramble](https://www.hangbug.com/games/code-scramble): Reassemble shuffled programming statements under time limits.
- [Missing Code](https://www.hangbug.com/games/missing-code): Fill in missing keywords and operators in multi-language snippets.
- [Logic Builder](https://www.hangbug.com/games/logic-builder): Solve algorithmic flow and condition-ordering puzzles.
- [Memory Match](https://www.hangbug.com/games/memory-match): Match programming concepts, syntax patterns, and definitions.
- [Complete The Code](https://www.hangbug.com/games/complete-the-code): Interactive C# method body and keyword completion challenges.

## Published Tutorials & Guides

- [HTML Tutorial for Beginners](https://www.hangbug.com/blog/html-tutorial-for-beginners): Semantic HTML5 structure, forms, accessibility, and SEO basics.
- [CSS Basics Beginner Guide](https://www.hangbug.com/blog/css-basics-beginners-guide): Selectors, Flexbox, Grid, box model, and responsive design.
- [JavaScript Fundamentals Guide](https://www.hangbug.com/blog/javascript-fundamentals-beginners-guide): Variables, ES6+ syntax, DOM manipulation, and asynchronous programming.
- [PHP Programming Beginner Guide](https://www.hangbug.com/blog/php-programming-beginners-guide): Server-side PHP 8 syntax, OOP principles, and secure database queries.
- [Laravel MVC Architecture](https://www.hangbug.com/blog/laravel-basics-mvc-architecture): Routing, controllers, Blade templates, and Eloquent ORM fundamentals.
- [Flutter & Dart Mobile Development](https://www.hangbug.com/blog/flutter-dart-mobile-app-development): Reactive widgets, null safety, and cross-platform Android UI building.
